storage: Trim the roots, wrap the bunch in a dry paper towel and keep it in a box in the fridge, or stand the stems in a glass of water, loosely covered. Chop only when needed.
looksLike: A bunch of flat, lobed, bright green leaves on thin stems, with a strong fresh citrusy smell.
howToPick: Bright green, perky leaves with a strong smell; avoid yellowing, slimy or wilted bunches.
shelfLife: 3 to 5 days in the fridge when stored well (general guidance; not taken from a source in this run).
substitutes: Mint leaves or curry leaves (for garnish)

usedIn.raw: 12 g per serving (8 g in chutney, 4 g garnish).
